text:
sophie: Heads-up: starting schema migration for user_addresses in 10m. backfill is conditional — only for users with `legacy_address = true`. plan: gate + rate-limited backfill.
deploybot: deploy scheduled: migration v2.3.1 on prod in 10m. Holdpoints: `db-lock-check`, `row-backfill-rate`.
mike: What's the intended rate? want to avoid replica lag spikes.
sophie: Start at 50 rows/sec, ramp to 200 over 30m, monitor replica lag > 200ms -> abort.
jen: Can we gate via feature flag? If ff off, backfill should be a no-op.
sophie: Yes — gate = `ff:user.address_migrate`. backfill respects gate.
kevin: How are we pinning app version? Need to avoid workers touching the new col before backfill done.
sophie: We'll pin web-workers to `release/canary` for 2h. rollback = unpin + revert migration if lock contention.
deploybot: preflight checks passed: replica_lag=12ms, db_conns=420, locks_free=true.
mike: OK proceeding. I'll watch replica lag and set alert if >200ms. tagging @oncall-db.
oncall-db: watching; will escalate at 3x baseline.
sophie: Starting now. backfill command: `python tools/backfill.py --table user_addresses --rate 50 --gate ff:user.address_migrate`
carol: saw a small spike in p99 tx time, recommend dropping ramp to 80/sec.
sophie: acknowledged, lowering to 80 and holding. abort if lag > 500ms.
deploybot: migration step 'apply-schema' completed. duration 17s.
sophie: backfill progress: 4% after 10m. dashboards look green.
mike: lag creeping to 310ms, lowering to 40/sec now.
jen: adding a note to release draft: "user_addresses migration — gated backfill; no user-facing downtime expected."
carol: If we need to abort, what's the exact escape hatch?
sophie: Escape hatch: stop backfill, flip ff to `off`, unpin app workers. Schema is backward compatible, so revert safe.
oncall-db: replica lag peaked at 612ms at 11:28 UTC, cleared after rate dropped. No stuck replicas.
sophie: thanks — continuing at 40/sec. will re-evaluate at +1h.
mike: :thumbsup:
deploybot: migration finished: backfill completed 1,243,892 rows. Summary: peak_lag=612ms, failed_tx=0, total_time=1h42m. Running postchecks.
sophie: postchecks OK. unpinning app workers in 5m.
jen: prepping final rollback doc just in case, but looks clean.
sophie: proceeding to unpin now. great job team :party:
kevin: logging post-mortem notes + tagging retention policy.
jen: updating release notes with final metrics and adding note about gate + rate limits.
